articles.summary: 外部记忆让 LLM agent 能复用历史经验，但不当教训会引发「记忆诱导退化」，使 agent 在原本可解的任务上失败。论文提出证据关联式记忆机制，将记忆条目与其来源证据绑定，抑制错误迁移，减少记忆造成的性能下降。

articles.title: Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits

articles.summary: 延续「权重空间编程」思路，提出 Tree-Ising 位级 Ising 编辑，直接在权重上「修复」语言模型：无需梯度，通过结构化搜索定位并翻转关键比特，替代此前需 158 轮 agent 交互、近 9000 万 token 的 agent 式修复流程。

articles.title: One Table, Many Queries: Benchmarking Generalist Tabular Models Across Generation, Imputation, and Prediction
articles.excerpt: Generation, imputation, and prediction query different aspects of the same tabular distribution, but are usually evaluated separately. articles.summary: 表格生成、插补与预测查询同一分布的不同侧面，却长期分开评测，难以判断能力是否共享、训练目标如何相互影响。论文提出 One Table, Many Queries 基准，在同一批表格上统一评测通用表格模型的三类任务表现与迁移。

articles.title: Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks

articles.title: SteerDistill: Quantizing LLM Agents via Closed-Loop Teacher Steering
articles.excerpt: Low-bit quantization reduces the inference cost of LLM agents but can compromise task success. Examining failed rollouts, we find that quantized agents overlook task requirements or environmental conditions, producing environment transitions that diverge from successful full-precision references. Co
articles.summary: 低比特量化可降低 LLM agent 推理成本，却损害任务成功率。作者分析失败轨迹发现，量化 agent 常忽略任务要求与环境条件，产生偏离全精度参考的状态转移；据此提出 SteerDistill，用闭环教师引导蒸馏纠正偏差，恢复低比特下的任务表现。

articles.title: MACaQ: Fast, Model Agnostic Calibrated Quantization for Low-Precision Weights and Activations
articles.excerpt: Weight-activation quantization can reduce the memory and compute cost of neural-network inference, but recent methods often require expensive optimization and architecture-specific propagation of basis transforms across layers. We introduce MACaQ, an MXFP4 W4A4 post-training quantization method that
articles.summary: 权重-激活量化能降低推理显存与算力开销，但现有方法常需昂贵优化，并在层间传播与架构绑定的基变换。论文提出 MACaQ，一种 MXFP4 W4A4 训练后量化方法，以模型无关的方式快速校准权重与激活，避免逐层优化带来的额外成本。

articles.title: Incentivizing Self-Learning in Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
articles.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) draw on parametric knowledge and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to solve knowledge-intensive tasks. Yet problem solving in unfamiliar domains calls for tightly coupled knowledge acquisition and reasoning, beyond factual retrieval and aggregation or learning solely
articles.summary: 在陌生领域，LLM 仅靠参数知识或 RAG 检索事实难以支撑紧耦合的知识获取与推理。论文提出用强化学习激励模型自学习：训练模型主动获取并内化新知识再据此推理，而非仅做事实检索与聚合。

articles.title: Embodied First Exam
articles.excerpt: Early successes on agentic robotics point to a potential paradigm shift toward using coding agents to control robots. articles.title: MMDM: Measuring Massive Multitask Decision Making

articles.title: FINCOSMOS: An Open-World Evaluation Paradigm for Agents in Finance

articles.summary: 金融场景中语言 agent 需从开放 Web 取数、揣摩用户未明说的策略，且正确性随时间变化，容易悄无声息地失败。论文提出 FINCOSMOS 开放世界评测范式，用可核查的时间敏感任务检验 agent 的数据来源、策略遵循与结论正确性。

articles.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Deleting Weights in LLM Post-Training
